lines.t: Running through alleys of memory and fear I build up these walls, I disappear
Echoes chase me, calling my name Truth of who I am, buried in blame
Lame intentions tangled, I play my disguise But the king sees through in his eyes
Late night confessions, begging for peace Tryna outrun the call, really
Power and wisdom chase me down Mercy breaking every frown
When the light invades my soul I crumble, lose control
The feet are sweeter than resistance Love fills the distance
Surrender like Jonah in the deep I accept the call
No secrets to keep
Counting the cost, I hid in a crowd Faith on the fringe, never allowed
But your love is relentless Burning through, brings out my destiny
And he makes me true
Unintentional fall, intentional fly
Still prayers crashing, making it right
Unravel me gently with tears in your hand
You fold me into your greater plan
I myself in darkness, think I'm safe
Your wisdom cuts me, can't escape
Called and chosen, but I act confused
You undo my reasons, break every rules Running nowhere, but the shadow moves
The voice gets louder, spirit-proof Power and wisdom chase me down
Mercy breaking every frown When the light invades my soul
I crumble, lose control Defeat is sweeter than resistance
Distance, love fills the distance Surrender like Jonah in the deep
I accept the call, no secret to keep
Chains of my making, locked by the lies You shatter the cycles, open my eyes
Kneeling in silence, unable to flee Your arms surround, awaken me
Dawn after darkness, promise unfolds
Will melting past, heart becoming bold
Servant's destiny, I rise from the dust
Your will is perfect, your love I trust
Power and wisdom chase me down
Mercy breaking every frown
When the light invades my soul
I crumble, lose control
Defeated sweeter than resistance
Love fills the distance
Surrender like Jonah in the deep
I accept the call
No secrets to keep
Power and wisdom chase me down
Mercy breaking every frown
When the light invades my soul
I crumble, lose control
True, defeat is sweeter than resistance Love fills the distance
Surrender like Jonah in the deep I accept the call, no secrets to keep
Now I'm found, not my way but yours Serving by grace, open doors
Victory and surrender, purpose reborn Rise up, servants
Let the call be a dawn
